GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok going Through went to second Two Wide 1-2 Lengths (800m), closed that gap Soon After , Ridden Along Straight leader kept on going # no match winner

Jumped Ok , nice sit Mid Field Two Wide With Cover 5 Lengths 700m, came 3 Wide on the corner but gave Leader a start, gradually got going last 200m and wore down Leader but had to settle for close minor placing # grinding placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered and taken wider near the 650m. A post-race vet exam revealed a small laceration to the off foreleg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 6th Inside 4 Lengths off Inside Turning for home clear run home Outside quickened from 200m (tt/t/1st) ran on # strong late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced awkwardly at heels near the 500m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well rails gate Not Bustled to lead settled down fourth trailing 3 Lengths (800m), same to turn & into the Straight urged along, faded out of it Not Knocked About last 120 # jock sat up 120
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported filly may not have been suited to track conditions.

Shifted inwards on jumping bumping JUNGLE WONDER and carrying that runner inwards to bump with MUSSE DE LOUVRE. Raced wide in the early stages. Raced ungenerously in the early and middle stages. Briefly held up in the early stages of the home straight. Raced greenly in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Not Bustled from Outside Drifted Back Settled Down rear 6 Lengths off leader/winner , Hard Ridden Straightening Up 4th x 100m, 3rd x line, Sound Effort ! # sat too far back

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , Moved Up to within a long head turning, carted off track by leader on turn, recovered some to run 5th. [Stewards: Hampered early and carried very Wide from 600m and around home turn.] # Had excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered early and carried very wide from the 600m and around the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Not Bustled settled down Two Wide 5 Lengths off the lead (800m), off heels lost a length or So Soon After & then held up before Turn & into the Straight , Clear 200 made ground ( Blinkers First Time ) # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. When racing keenly passing the 700m, checked from heels. Held up for clear running from passing the 400m until passing the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward sat 2nd Outside 1/2 Lengths off leader/winner race run to suit , Ridden Along Turning for home couldn't quicken Couldn'T Go On @ 100m, looked good at trials, - minor abrasions to both forelegs consistent with speedy cuts - to the eye had not one excuse, was # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 100m, when placed under pressure, shifted out, bumped and became unbalanced. When asked about performance, Rdr reported filly was inclined to race greenly and when placed under pressure in the home straight, failed to respond to riding and proved disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed minor abrasions to both forelegs consistent with speedy cuts.
